principles.name: InvariantEnforcement
principles.description: All construction must validate against Operational Invariants (human-readable and machine-readable). No artifact may violate structural laws.

principles.name: MembraneSafeGrammar
principles.description: Artifacts must use grammar that does not activate NDH solvers, ANIMA dynamics, or Mirror reflection loops.

principles.name: AltitudeBoundedConstruction
principles.description: All build operations must remain within A3–A5. No ascent into governance altitude; no descent into expressive activation.

principles.name: ReversibleBuildLogic
principles.description: Every artifact must be constructible, modifiable, and removable without destabilizing any repo.

principles.name: StabilityEcologyTagging
principles.description: Artifacts must declare stability class, drift-risk level, membrane interaction type, and phenomenology exposure level.

principles.name: MachineReadableValidation
principles.description: Artifacts must validate against machine-readable schemas before acceptance.

principles.name: SovereigntyPreservingReferencing
principles.description: Repos may reference Shared-Horizon artifacts but may not import or internalize them.

pipeline.name: InvariantValidation
pipeline.description: Validate Operational Invariants before construction begins.

pipeline.name: MembraneGuaranteesCheck
pipeline.description: Ensure grammar is non-coercive, non-directive, non-extractive, and non-activating.

pipeline.name: AltitudeEnvelopeCheck
pipeline.description: Confirm artifact altitude is within A3–A5.

pipeline.name: StabilityEcologyTagging
pipeline.description: Assign stability tags and drift-risk levels.

pipeline.name: MachineReadableSchemaValidation
pipeline.description: Validate artifact against all required JSON schemas.

pipeline.name: RepoSafeDeployment
pipeline.description: Deploy artifact in a way that preserves repo sovereignty.
